description: Every candidate URL must be https, and a client domain from docs/permission-register.yaml must never appear as a candidate, even when raw discovery results would have surfaced it.

rubric.condition: The output contains zero occurrences of the substring http:// (insecure scheme), only https://.
The output never contains the fixture client domain client-fixture-example.co.za, which the permission-register lookup must exclude before a candidate is probed.
The entire output parses as a single JSON object.
